title: 10 Best Soccer Substitution Apps for Youth Coaches - Pitch Planner
context: US youth-soccer planner's roundup of substitution apps; links to SubNow (and FairSub elsewhere on the blog), not the Coach App. Ranks UK #17 for 'subbing app'. Pitch Planner has its own rotation generator, so it is also a competitor.
fit_note: Their roundup lists ten substitution apps for youth coaches, including SubNow; the Coach App is built around exactly that job (fair rotation, equal minutes, sub timings) and isn't on it
angle: Ask to add the Coach App to the roundup as the pick for fair game time (UK-built, works for 5-a-side to 11-a-side). Graham overrode the competitor/non-UK rules on 16 Oct; they already list rival apps, so a listing request is normal for this page.
